search.hint: Search by vendor, ref or order number or job

assumptions.why: Built by build.mjs from system/model/expense.json and pages/list/expenses.intent.json. Edit those, not this file.
L-name-first: the model says people know one by vendor, ref or order number and job, in that order; codes go to the second line.
L-slot: expenses are named after their vendor, a company, but aren't one: the name already says who.
L-name-first: job has its own column, so it isn't repeated on the second line; on a phone, where the columns go, the row's bottom line shows it.

assumptions.value: Total, Status, Job, Type, Waiver, Date created shown; Vendor, Client, Submitted by hidden
assumptions.why: L-priority: the key figure, the status, then what the intent says people look at, in order (lookAt); the model's other fields stay available, hidden.
L-summary: KPIs, the default: what the intent's tasks act on; each adds up total, the key figure, its count beside.
L-filters: the status (tasks are about statuses) and what tasks find rows by, pinned; kinds, people and the key figure after.
L-sort: the main date, newest first.
L-row-click: peek, the system's default; the thing has no full-screen window of its own.
L-related: the records an expense connects to in the model (the job's client through it).
L-create: expenses are added to a list the business keeps.
L-next-step: the lifecycle's next step for each status; it leads the record and the ··· menu.
L-icons: system/model/icons.json, by meaning, record, type, label or verb.
